fields.name: ClientInstanceId
fields.about: The client instance id that was provided by the broker in the GetTelemetrySubscriptionsResponse.

fields.name: SubscriptionId
fields.about: The subscription id that was provided by the broker in the GetTelemetrySubscriptionsResponse.

fields.about: The compression type used for the metrics payload.
